adapter: raceintel/simulation/driver_status.py (RAW_ADAPTER_VERSION v3.2j-raw-adapter-v1; stdlib-only, no network, no labels)
artifacts: tracked under results/v3/v3_2j/ (manifest, hashes, transitions, firewalls, coverage); raw streams ignored under data/raw/fastf1_cache/v3_2j_timing/
fetch_required_raw: .venv/bin/python scripts/fetch_v3_2j_streams.py  # resume-safe; official host then FastF1 mirror fallback; records served_by per race
freeze_manifest: .venv/bin/python scripts/build_v3_2j_manifest.py  # population from frozen replay catalogue, never from download success
run_tests: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_v3_2j_status_models.py  # Tier-1 source-safe; corpus tests in tests/test_v3_2j_status_corpus.py (Tier-3)
run_validation: .venv/bin/python scripts/validate_v3_2j_new_states.py  # 14 x 500-sim runs + API refusal + performance
verify_hashes: .venv/bin/python scripts/build_v3_2j_manifest.py  # asserts cached shas; fetch_report.json records fetched shas
